name: osv-scanner
description: Google's official vulnerability scanner (v2 with osv-scalibr) that finds existing vulnerabilities affecting your project's dependencies using the OSV database

osv-scanner.description: Comprehensive vulnerability scanner for open source dependencies with guided remediation, container image scanning, and osv-scalibr-powered SBOM extraction
osv-scanner.usage:
osv-scanner --help
osv-scanner --version
osv-scanner scan source -r ./my-project
osv-scanner scan source --lockfile=package-lock.json
osv-scanner scan image alpine:latest
osv-scanner scan source --format=json --output=results.json ./project
osv-scanner fix --lockfile=package-lock.json
